copy.headline: ‘It’s Not Just a Song on the Radio’: How Music Became A Main Character In ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’
copy.caption: In their first major interviews about the sonic universe of the culture-changing game, Rockstar Games and soundtrack composers Justice pull back the curtain on their mission to make Vice City sing.
